member.name: T:SysWeaver.HttpBench.BenchRun
member.summary: One test: the workers that call the end points and the metrics they collect. Every worker is a client of its own (a connection pool of one connection and a cookie jar, so one server session per worker) that calls the selected end points in order, one request at a time, until the time is up. The metrics are kept per end point and second, so every table and chart is built from the same data.
